_comment: Map regions for the scenic/historic roads map. bbox is Overpass order (south,west,north,east). A region with a null bbox is queried WORLDWIDE (no bbox clause). Override the whole file with FW_ROAD_REGIONS_FILE=/path.

world.label: Worldwide
world._note: Worldwide is data-viable but HEAVY: measured 2026-08-27 it returns ~89,900 segments / ~49 MB of GeoJSON, which inlines into an unwieldy page. Prefer the per-continent regions and render several maps.

historic_route_exclusions._comment: route=historic is a weak tag: a handful of relations carrying it are actually public-transport or interurban RAIL routes, not historic roads (measured in North America 2026-08-27: 6 of 49 — three Salem/Keizer bus routes, a CTA route, and two interurban electric railways). A relation is dropped from the historic-roads layer when its operator or network contains any pattern below, case-insensitively. Best-effort cleanup of upstream mistagging, not an exhaustive filter.

layer_sources._comment: Overpass selectors per layer. Measured in North America 2026-08-28, the per-way tags alone are badly under-applied and geographically biased: scenic=yes covers 4,915 km with only 428 distinct names, dominated by a handful of Florida roads. The DESIGNATED routes are modelled as route RELATIONS carrying a network tag (US:CO:Scenic, US:OH:Byway, US:NHT, US:auto_trail, ...), which yields 36,404 km of scenic and 56,185 km of historic - 8x and 28x more. Both are unioned and deduplicated by way id. Relation members are always gated on being [highway]. A relation selector may be a plain string, or an object with verify_highway_members=true. That extra check costs a SECOND Overpass query that recurses to every member (way(r.r)[highway]) and 504s on wide selectors, so it is opt-in: route=road already means road, while route=historic mixes in railways and transit and genuinely needs it.

_simplify_comment: Ramer-Douglas-Peucker tolerance in degrees (~33 m) applied to every road geometry. The full-density continental set is 81.6 MB, too large to inline into an HTML page; these maps are viewed at zoom ~3-9 where 33 m is well under a pixel. 0 disables. Override with FW_ROAD_SIMPLIFY_DEG.
